plainText:
Minoru Inaba (Japanese: 稲葉実 Inaba Minoru) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Inaba was born on November 8, 1951, in , , . As an adult, he became a voice actor and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1970s. Inaba lent his voice to Pokémon animation on three occasions: first as Mr. Fuji during the Pokémon Origins miniseries, then as Coumarine City Gym Leader Ramos during , and then as in the twenty-second movie, replacing Yosuke Akimoto. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
